patches.name: High Quality Audio Export & Audio Tools - Moises
patches.description: Bypasses client-side audio bitrate export caps (enabling 320kbps MP3 and WAV export options) and unlocks unlimited audio pitch shift, tempo changes, Smart Metronome, and chord detection in Moises (v2.7.2 recommandée).

patches.name: Unlock Premium & Pro Features - Moises
patches.description: Hooks Google Play BillingClient, RevenueCat EntitlementInfo, and subscription data models in Moises (v2.7.2 recommandée) to unlock client-side Pro features, bypass startup upgrade paywalls, Smart Metronome, chord detection, and pitch/speed controls.

patches.name: Allow Screenshots & Block Telemetry - Perplexity (Experimental)

patches.name: AMOLED Dark Theme & Declutter - Perplexity (Experimental)

patches.name: Clean Links & Fast Copy - Perplexity (Experimental)
patches.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Strips tracking redirects from cited web sources in Perplexity answers and enables one-tap formatted markdown export.

patches.name: AMOLED Black Theme - Proton Mail (Experimental)

patches.name: Declutter UI & Hide Upsells - Proton Mail (Experimental)

patches.name: Enhanced Privacy & Tracker Blocker - Proton Mail (Experimental)

patches.name: Aggressive Keep-Alive & Auto-Reconnect - Proton VPN (Experimental)

patches.name: Allow Screenshots & Screen Mirroring - Proton VPN (Experimental)

patches.name: AMOLED Black Theme - Proton VPN (Experimental)

patches.name: Declutter UI & Hide Upsells - Proton VPN (Experimental)

patches.name: Enhanced Privacy & Telemetry Blocker - Proton VPN (Experimental)

patches.name: Unlock Custom DNS Settings - Proton VPN (Experimental)

patches.name: Unlock NetShield DNS Blocker - Proton VPN (Experimental)

patches.name: Allow Screenshots & Screen Security Bypass - SimpleX (Experimental)

patches.name: AMOLED Dark Theme - SimpleX (Experimental)

patches.name: Unlock Pro & Multi-Profile Switching - SimpleX (Experimental)
patches.description: ⚠️ [En cours de développement / Non testé] Unlocks instant multi-profile quick switching, quantum-resistant encryption toggles, and donor profile styling in SimpleX Chat.

patches.name: Unlock AllTrails+ & Offline Maps - AllTrails (Experimental)

patches.name: AMOLED Dark Theme - Claude AI (Experimental)

patches.name: Bypass Input Length & Upload Limits - Claude AI (Experimental)

patches.name: Unlimited Brand Kit Slots - Canva (Experimental)

patches.name: Unlock Canva Pro Features (Experimental)

patches.name: Unlock High Quality Export - Canva (Experimental)

patches.name: App refresh rate - YouTube (Experimental)
